description_short: The University of Twente's ITC Faculty runs the Early Bird Programme for students unconditionally admitted to its MSc Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation or MSc Spatial Systems & Society, starting September 2027. The single, strict application deadline is 31 January 2027.
